description:
Anime C (EdoEraAnime) is trained on MidJourney Images that use my "Personalised Style" + a rich mix of anime influences, primarily focusing on traditional Japanese themes. Approximately 25% of the dataset emphasizes the "Blue Eye Samurai" style, evoking iconic samurai aesthetics.

SDXL, Pont trigger words are ArsMJStyle, AnimeC

Flux trigger is EdoEraAnime. (The caption was completely reworked for Flux)

Works great in the 0.2 - 1.2 range, depending on the Lora Stack you use.

The training images are really sharp , so you can go pretty high and still get a coherent images.

Above 1.2 everything starts getting abstract for SDXL/Pony.
Flux works without any issues up to 1.5

I recommend starting in the 0.8 - 1 range on all versions.
